d: Every great delivery experience starts behind the scenes. As a LiveOps Executive at Snoonu, you’ll be the operational heartbeat keeping our delivery network alive across Oman. You’ll work at the intersection of riders, merchants, and technology, making real-time decisions that directly shape what customers feel on the other end.
q: 0–2 years of experience in operations, logistics, last-mile delivery, or a fast-paced coordination role.
Strong organisational skills — you can juggle multiple moving parts without losing sight of priorities.
Clear, confident communicator, comfortable working with field teams, partners, and internal stakeholders alike.
Comfortable working with data: able to read dashboards, maintain trackers, and flag anomalies quickly.
Problem-solver proactive mindset: you don't wait for someone else to fix an issue; you own it and escalate when needed.
Fluent in English and Arabic given the operational context across Oman.
Prior experience in food delivery, ride-hailing, or a super app environment.
Familiarity with dispatch tools, fleet management systems, or Google Maps / KML zone mapping.
Basic knowledge of Omanisation regulations and 3PL compliance frameworks.
Any additional language is win! (Urdu, Hindi, French, SQL)

d: Company Description Al Fanar School Dubai is a pioneering primary school where the British Curriculum is blended with holistic values, nature-based learning, and heart-led education. The school is committed to nurturing the intellectual, emotional, and physical development of every child through a unique and thoughtfully designed curriculum. Located in Nad Al Sheba, Al Fanar School is closely connected to the land and community it serves. The school environment reflects the diverse languages and layered cultures of the UAE, creating an inclusive and enriching setting for learners and educators alike.

Role Description The Primary Teacher Year 5 will plan, deliver, and assess engaging lessons aligned with the British Curriculum, ensuring learning is differentiated and appropriate for a diverse group of students. The role involves creating a positive, inclusive classroom environment that supports holistic development, behavior management, and the social-emotional wellbeing of learners. The teacher will collaborate with colleagues to integrate nature-based and experiential learning, contribute to school initiatives, and participate in staff meetings, professional development, and school events. Regular communication with families regarding student progress and supporting the broader school community are key aspects of the role. This is a full-time, on-site position based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
q: Relevant teaching qualification, such as a Bachelor’s degree in Education or a related field, and recognized teaching certification for primary education.
Proven experience teaching Year 5 or upper primary within a British Curriculum or similar international framework.
Strong classroom management, lesson planning, and assessment skills, with the ability to differentiate instruction for varied learning needs.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to work effectively with students, families, and colleagues from diverse cultural backgrounds.
Commitment to holistic and nature-based education, fostering students’ intellectual, emotional, and physical development.
Competence in integrating educational technologies to support teaching, learning, and reporting where appropriate.
Flexibility, resilience, and a reflective approach to practice, with a willingness to engage in ongoing professional learning.
Previous teaching experience in the UAE or GCC region and familiarity with local cultural context is an advantage.
